issues.on_page: Line 39 Debt Service 14,400.00 (Water Fund column, printed under the 'Governmental' heading)
issues.issue: The row sits in the governmental section of the form but the amount is in the Water Fund column. Calling it business-type follows the fund column, which is defensible, but the form's own heading says governmental.

The Reserve Fund (purpose not stated) is treated as governmental and gets 15,000 from the Sewer Fund. As a result the governmental transfers (in 21,550 / out 6,550) and business_type.transfers_net -15,000 are one-sided by fund type. This ties to the interfund schedule (p3), but the Reserve Fund's type is an assumption.
